summary: First structured intensity introduced — 2x6min sweet-spot on Tuesday embedded in an otherwise aerobic week, anchored by a 90-min Zone 2 ride on Thursday.

sessions.name: Sweet-Spot Intro Ride
sessions.focus: 2x6min upper Z3 sweet-spot — first structured stimulus of Block 2

sessions.name: Lower Body & Core — Shoulder-Free
sessions.focus: Strength endurance foundation, core stability, protect shoulder

sessions.name: Long Aerobic Ride
sessions.focus: 90-min Zone 2 anchor — primary aerobic adaptation stimulus of the week

summary: Build progresses — sweet-spot reps extended to 3x8min on Tuesday, Thursday long ride extends to 100 minutes, strength moves to 3 rounds.

sessions.name: Easy Aerobic Run
sessions.focus: Zone 1-2, extend to 35 min, aerobic continuity

sessions.name: Sweet-Spot Development Ride
sessions.focus: 3x8min at 155-168W — progression from 2x6min, more time at stimulus

sessions.name: Lower Body & Core — 3 Rounds
sessions.focus: Step to 3 rounds, introduce 22kg on goblet squat and RDL

summary: Peak week — Tuesday introduces first true threshold intervals (3x10min Z4), Thursday long ride holds at 100 min, run extends slightly. Highest intensity week of the block.

sessions.name: Easy Aerobic Run
sessions.focus: Zone 1-2 easy 35 min — keep legs fresh ahead of Tuesday

sessions.name: Threshold Intervals
sessions.focus: 3x10min at 169-185W (Z4) — first true threshold work of Block 2

sessions.name: Lower Body & Core — Peak
sessions.focus: 3 rounds at peak loads — 22kg throughout, add single-leg RDL

sessions.name: Long Aerobic Ride
sessions.focus: 100-min Zone 2 — consolidate aerobic base before recovery week

summary: Recovery week — volume drops ~40%, intensity disappears entirely. All sessions Zone 1-2 only. Supercompensation from the build/peak block lands here.

sessions.name: Short Easy Run
sessions.focus: 20 min Zone 1 only — active recovery, nothing more

sessions.name: Easy Spin
sessions.focus: 30 min Zone 1-2 easy — flush legs, no structure

sessions.name: Mobility & Light Activation
sessions.focus: 1 round only, light loads — maintain pattern, not stimulus

sessions.name: Zone 2 Aerobic Ride — Recovery Length
sessions.focus: 60 min easy Zone 2 — shortened anchor, let adaptation consolidate
